title: Dragon and Candlelit Revelry
description: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a large blonde woman in a dark blue corset standing atop a massive blue dragon adorned with lit candles. In the background, another version of the woman holds candles while a transparent bubble on the right contains three people in formal attire enjoying cocktails under a starry purple sky with constellations and flowing banners.
prompt: A majestic blonde woman in a dark blue corset and braided hair stands confidently on the head of a giant blue dragon covered in lit black candles, her hand on her hip. In the starry purple night sky, a smaller version of her floats holding candles with a blue banner reading 'D.T. Kelly'. To the right, a transparent bubble contains a woman in a black dress, a red-haired woman, and a man in a pinstripe suit toasting with blue cocktails, all rendered in rich fantasy illustration style.
